articles.headline: Hawks' Flemings suspended for elbowing Pelicans' McGowens in head
articles.description: Hawks guard Kingston Flemings was suspended for a game by the NBA on Sunday night for intentionally elbowing Pelicans guard Bryce McGowens in the head.

articles.headline: Thunder decline option for oft-injured ex-lottery pick Nikola Topic
articles.description: The Thunder declined to pick up Nikola Topic's option for next season, making the Serbian point guard a free agent next summer.

articles.headline: Porter, Randle help Nets to 98-90 victory over Pacers
articles.description: — Michael Porter Jr. scored 23 points, and Julius Randle had 20 points to lead the Brooklyn Nets to a 98-90 victory over the Indiana Pacers on Sunday night.

articles.headline: Jayson Tatum's 32, Paul George's 10 4th-quarter points lead Boston Celtics to win at Orlando
articles.description: — Jayson Tatum scored 32 points — 15 of them from the free-throw line — and Paul George added 17 as the Boston Celtics won their fifth straight, 108-97 over the Orlando Magic Sunday.
